title: Pasado — contá una vida
goals: Meta declarada por el material: describir hechos pasados y escribir la biografía de alguien.
Decí las fechas en voz alta, uní los hechos con conectores y manejá el past simple de regulares e irregulares.
Cerrá contando una vida entera en cien palabras.

aspects.title: Fechas
aspects.summary: Cómo se escriben y —sobre todo— cómo se dicen: nineteen ninety-eight, twenty ten, two thousand and five.

aspects.title: Conectores
aspects.summary: and, but, because y so: unir dos hechos del pasado en una sola oración.

aspects.title: Was y were
aspects.summary: La primera puerta del pasado: el verbo be, singular y plural.

aspects.title: Past simple regular
aspects.summary: El -ed y sus reglas de ortografía, el auxiliar did y las tres formas: afirmativa, negativa e interrogativa.

aspects.title: Verbos irregulares de la unidad
aspects.summary: Los 35 que los ejercicios y las biografías de esta unidad realmente usan. Los temas siguientes cubren el resto de la lista, por patrón.

aspects.title: Contar una vida
aspects.summary: La meta de la unidad: Shakespeare, Frida Kahlo y García Lorca como modelos para escribir una biografía.

aspects.title: El pasado no cambia
aspects.summary: Base y pasado idénticos: solo el contexto dice cuál es. El grupo más fácil y el más traicionero al escuchar.

aspects.title: El grupo -ought / -aught
aspects.summary: Siete verbos muy frecuentes que terminan todos igual. Aprendido el sonido, se aprenden los siete.

aspects.title: Los que terminan en -t
aspects.summary: Cambian la vocal y cierran en t. Muchos son verbos de todos los días.

aspects.title: La vocal i pasa a a
aspects.summary: Familia clarísima: sing/sang, drink/drank. Si reconocés el patrón, no hace falta memorizar uno por uno.

aspects.title: Los que hacen -o- u -ó-
aspects.summary: write/wrote, break/broke, speak/spoke: la vocal se cierra en o. El grupo más grande.

aspects.title: El grupo -ew
aspects.summary: know/knew, grow/grew, throw/threw. Seis verbos que riman en pasado.

aspects.title: Los que van solos
aspects.summary: No siguen ninguna familia: hay que aprenderlos de a uno. Son también los más usados.

source.note: El -ed tiene tres pronunciaciones y solo una agrega sílaba. Es LA trampa del pasado regular.

The next year they ___ (move) to New York.

atoms.prompt: Uní las dos oraciones con AND, BUT, BECAUSE o SO.

items.stem: John took a bath early in the morning ___ he had to go to the doctor.
The family had dinner very quickly ___ they wanted to go to the museum.
Bella took off her slippers ___ she went to bed afterwards.

Greg put a reminder on his finger ___ he did not forget the meeting.

source.note: Narrativa nuestra sobre García Lorca, a partir de las notas que da el material para la producción final (pág. 21).

atoms.narrative: Federico García Lorca was a Spanish writer and poet. He was born in Fuente Vaqueros, near Granada, on the fifth of June, eighteen ninety-eight. He studied at the University of Granada from nineteen fourteen. In nineteen twenty-eight he wrote Romancero Gitano, and the book made him famous. A year later he visited New York, and the city changed his poetry. Back in Spain he wrote Bodas de Sangre, one of his most famous plays. He died near Granada on the nineteenth of August, nineteen thirty-six. He was only thirty-eight years old.

atoms.prompt: Write a biography (about 100 words). Include birth, job, education, career and death.
atoms.modelAnswer: Federico García Lorca was a Spanish writer and poet. He was born in Fuente Vaqueros, near Granada, on the fifth of June, eighteen ninety-eight. He studied at the University of Granada from nineteen fourteen. In nineteen twenty-eight he wrote Romancero Gitano, and the book made him famous all over Spain. A few years later he visited New York, and the city changed his poetry. When he returned, he wrote Bodas de Sangre, one of his most famous plays. He died near Granada on the nineteenth of August, nineteen thirty-six. He was only thirty-eight years old.
modelVariants: William Shakespeare was the greatest writer in the English language. He was born in Stratford-upon-Avon in fifteen sixty-four. At the age of eighteen he married Anne Hathaway, who was eight years older than himself. A few years later he moved to London, where he worked as an actor and playwright. He wrote thirty-seven plays and one hundred and fifty-four sonnets. His most famous plays are the four great tragedies. He died in Stratford-upon-Avon on the twenty-third of April, sixteen sixteen, but his plays are still popular today.
scaffold: 1. Quién fue: nombre + qué hacía (was a Spanish writer and poet).
2. Nacimiento: dónde y cuándo (was born in… on…).
3. Educación: dónde estudió y desde cuándo.
4. La obra que lo hizo conocido, con su año.
5. Un giro en la carrera (un viaje, una mudanza).
6. Muerte: dónde, cuándo y con qué edad.

atoms.modelAnswer: Frida Kahlo was a Mexican painter. She was born in Mexico City in nineteen oh seven, and she painted many self-portraits and paintings of Mexican folklore. In nineteen twenty-two she went to the Escuela Preparatoria, a prestigious school where at that time there were not many girls. Three years later, at the age of eighteen, she had a terrible traffic accident. She could not walk for a long time, so she started painting. In nineteen twenty-nine she married the painter Diego Rivera. They moved to New York, but she was not happy there and they returned to Mexico. She won a national art prize in nineteen forty-six and became famous. She died in nineteen fifty-four, when she was only forty-seven.

steps.segment: In nineteen twenty-two she went to the Escuela Preparatoria, a prestigious school where at that time there were not many girls.
steps.hint: El dato de las pocas chicas es del texto: no lo pierdas.

steps.segment: Three years later, at the age of eighteen, she had a terrible traffic accident.
steps.hint: "Three years later" encadena con la fecha anterior.

steps.prompt: How did that change her life?
steps.segment: She could not walk for a long time, so she started painting.
steps.hint: El so es el corazón del relato: la desgracia produce la obra.

steps.prompt: What about Diego Rivera and New York?
steps.segment: In nineteen twenty-nine she married the painter Diego Rivera. They moved to New York, but she was not happy there and they returned to Mexico.
steps.hint: El but marca que Nueva York no salió bien.

steps.segment: She won a national art prize in nineteen forty-six and became famous. She died in nineteen fifty-four, when she was only forty-seven.
steps.hint: Reconocimiento y muerte, con el "only" que le da el tono.
